features: PACKAGE INCLUDED - 50PCS Black Kraft Cupcake Boxes, 50PCS Cake Holder Insert

EASY TO PUT TOGETHER - Our cupcake boxes come in flat for easy delivery and storage. You just need to take a few minutes to assemble a box. Plus, there will be two windows on top and front respectively. So people can see whats inside clearly. Our insert is adjustable, so various cakes or candies have a snug fit with our container.

MULTIPLE OCCASIONS - It is ubiquitous that you give your neighbors or friends your home-made cupcakes. So our attractive and sturdy cake container should be in your consideration. Our cupcake container is perfect for baby shower, bride shower, wedding, birthday party, anniversary and all kinds of celebrations. Aside, our cake box can hold a wide variety of items such as macaron, cookies, candies, fruits, popcorns and any kinds snacks.

SIMPLE CUTE - A kraft cake container, painted in pink, adorable and exquisite. Our pink pastry box is more than a container. It is a showcase for your dessert. This box will make your cake more attractive and luxurious, look tastier.

PREMIUM QUALITY - Our cupcake individual container is made from food-grade kraft, thick and durable, wrinkle-resistant and high-strength, eco-friendly and odorless, can stand the weight up to 52.9 oz. The handle of this container is sturdy and firm, not easy to fall apart. Our container can effectively avoid the dessert exposing to air and dust. Keep the fresh and deliciousness for a long period of time.
